portableChecks: ./tests/run passed (133 Python tests plus structure checks) and omarchy plugin validate . passed on 2026-10-23.

liveChecks.device: SteelSeries Apex Pro TKL Gen 3 (1038:1642), firmware 1.19.7

results.oled: Clock, workspace, now-playing and text pages render correctly and update; 10px text legible.
results.rgb: Theme and wave modes show accurate colors on every key over direct HID; per-key writes leave unlisted keys untouched.
results.wheel: OLED-page mode scrolls both directions and click advances; workspace mode switches workspaces after the Lua dispatcher fix; volume default unaffected.
results.setup: Widget no longer installs on load; Set up button installs the service, which starts at login.
results.reactive: Not available on Gen 3 by design: the udev rule keeps keystroke interfaces root-only.

liveChecks.device: SteelSeries Apex Pro TKL Gen 3 (1038:1642, firmware 1.19.7); Logitech G502 Lightspeed (receiver 046d:c539 and wired 046d:c08d)

results.workspaceKeys: Number row follows workspaces 1-10 by colour from the event socket.
results.awayDark: Keyboard and OLED go dark with the screensaver and a blanked lock screen; waking the lock screen lights the keyboard.
results.claude: Claude page tracks sessions through the hooks; Esc flashes while a session waits for permission; 5-hour usage bar and reset countdown shown; idle background-daemon sessions are not counted.
results.cheatsheet: Bound keys light by category; holding Super shows the held layer after 0.25 s and clears on release, including after Super+Shift.
results.mouse: Lighting follows the keyboard; DPI set and restored; onboard-profile button remapping, desktop actions (F13-F18) and button identify work.
results.panel: Favorites, Mouse and Keyboard tabs render and drive the daemon.

notes: Apex 7 / Apex 7 TKL paths are unchanged in this release but were not re-tested on hardware.
